name: 30253 · Mcdonough, GA
findings: ZIP 30253 (Mcdonough) has 260 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30253 (Mcdonough) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30253 (Mcdonough) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
